interrupt_question: Authorial questions: (1) Does “3–6 months” describe time in Somatic Experiencing, time spent building capacity, or the whole Job 1 boundary—and is it an owner belief or a source-backed estimate? (2) Is “first” meant to survive only as a conditional possibility for some readers, or should all first-stage framing be removed? (3) Does “flexibility” mean physical flexibility, nervous-system/response flexibility, or both? (4) Should the reader-facing section explicitly name the high-dissociation, instability, active-danger, and insufficient-support boundary, or is that handled elsewhere? (5) Who is intended to judge presence, stopping ability, stability, and sufficient support: the reader, a practitioner, or both? Machine reasoning can resolve the sequence contradiction, missing actors, heading mismatch, quote attribution, and yin/long-hold distinction. Bounded research can assess the empirical modality, causality, outcome, safety, and duration claims, but cannot decide the owner’s intended meaning or acceptable framing.
